images.title: He whispers, she smirks — weathered stone
images.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: 9takes homepage hero photograph, vertical 4:5.
Image 1 is the edit target and composition reference. Image 2 is the PRIMARY MATERIAL reference: match its physically carved, dry, aged grey stone and unpainted blank eyes. Image 3 is only a photographic lighting and shadow reference; do not copy its figure, book, or setting.
Refresh image 1 to match the 9takes image-refresh visual standard. Preserve the two people, whispering action, their relationship, classical drapery and portrait composition. Keep the young adult man leaning toward the young adult woman's ear, one hand naturally cupped beside his mouth and the other resting on her shoulder. Keep her head slightly turned toward the viewer, lowered carved eyelids and a very subtle asymmetrical knowing half-smile: she has heard delicious gossip. The intimacy and tilt of their heads carry the humor; the smile must remain a plausible small expression chiseled in stone. Close mid-chest-up view.
Make this an editorial photograph of real life-sized Hellenistic antiquities, including stone eyes, hair, lips, fingers, bodies and robes. Material fidelity to image 2 is essential: dry matte marble or limestone, fine irregular pores, a few small edge chips, rubbed and worn chisel marks, subtle natural mineral mottling, a little embedded charcoal grime concentrated in recesses. Uneven believable weathering and weight. Solid stone eyes without living irises, pupils, sclera, wet highlights or eyelashes; attention conveyed by head direction and sculpted eyelids. Preserve distinct facial structures. No polished porcelain, skin painted grey, soft human flesh, wax, shiny resin, glossy CGI, uniform dirt overlay or decorative crack networks. Do not reproduce the damaged nose from the material reference.
Use one believable dominant raking side light from upper left, with natural falloff and retained detail in the charcoal shadows. Restrained ash-grey and chalk stone tones, neutral highlights, only the faintest warm reflected edge if needed. Natural photographic tonal range, fine detail, no glowy outlines or extra studio rim-light source.
Keep the nearly pure black, quiet background from the original. The figures are closely framed and centered, both complete heads in the upper half. Give a little breathing room around heads and essential hands so a 4:5 crop never cuts them off. Keep the whispering hand and shoulder hand clearly separated and anatomically coherent. The stone texture, proximity and gesture carry the image.
No additional people, props, architectural ornament, pedestal, books, text, symbols, logos, watermark, colored gels, neon, decorative gold, fantasy effects or exaggerated grimaces. One finished image only.
